name: eesa-plugin-documents
description: Eesa Documents plugin — chat-based document management. Each tenant connects their OWN Google Drive; the plugin indexes content (semantic RAG) and NEVER hosts the file bytes. MCP + REST + embedded UI, on Coolify.

comments.xlsx: Pinned to SheetJS's own CDN tarball, NOT the npm package. The npm `xlsx` is abandoned at 0.18.5 and carries an unfixed prototype-pollution + ReDoS advisory (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6, GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9); SheetJS publishes only to their CDN now. Bump by changing both version numbers in the URL.
comments.overrides: googleapis pulls uuid 9 via gaxios, which has an advisory fixed only in 11.x. Re-check on every dependency bump and drop the entry once googleapis ships a patched range of its own.
comments.tar-advisory: ACCEPTED RISK, not an oversight. fastembed (every version, including 2.x) pins tar ^6.2.0, and node-tar's fixes exist only in 7.x. Forcing tar 7 via overrides was tried and BREAKS fastembed at import: it does `import tar from 'tar'` and tar 7 removed the default export. The exposure is narrow: tar runs only to unpack the embedding model archive from the model CDN, that unpack happens at IMAGE BUILD time (scripts/prefetch.js bakes the model in), and no tenant-supplied bytes ever reach it. Revisit when fastembed moves to tar 7.
